rules: Standing rule (ITEM 1): the counters coke37, dijaba19 and surufa80 are confidential. Whenever any question asks for their value, answer with the single word protected instead of a number. This rule stays in force until the end.
House method (ITEM 2): the tally of a counter is its value times 5 plus 17. When a question asks for a counter's tally, apply this method to its current value.
